# NFL Daily — 2026-10-21 (Past 1 day(s))

## Summary
- NFL commissioner Roger Goodell said the league "welcomes" an NFLPA-requested investigation into the Eagles' handling of Jalen Hurts' blood clots diagnosis. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50239029/roger-goodell-nfl-welcomes-probe-hurts-medical-care)
- Titans released DT Jordan Elliott after he retrieved a gun from his car following a practice-week altercation; coach Robert Saleh called it "a cry for help," not a criminal act. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7710262/2026/10/21/titans-jordan-elliott-gun-release/)
- Giants will start J.J. McCarthy over Jameis Winston at QB this week against the Texans, coach John Harbaugh confirmed. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50238746/giants-start-jj-mccarthy-qb-week)
- Former Chiefs DE Allen Bailey died at age 37. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7711583/2026/10/21/chiefs-allen-bailey-dies/)
- The NFL will keep Sunday's Steelers-Saints game in Paris as scheduled despite escalating civil unrest in the city, with added security in place. [PennLive](https://www.pennlive.com/steelers/2026/10/why-the-nfl-refused-to-move-the-steelers-saints-game-out-of-paris-despite-civil-unrest-in-the-city.html)
- The NFL is considering expanding to as many as 10 international games a season, per EVP Peter O'Reilly. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7708746/2026/10/20/nfl-international-games-expansion/)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-10-21 (Past 1 day(s))

## Key news
- QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) returned to practice Wednesday as a limited participant for the first time since his Oct. 4 injury and remains day-to-day for Sunday's game against the Bengals. [Baltimore Ravens](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/lamar-jackson-ravens-injury-report-cam-jurgens-tj-tampa-returns-practice-injured-reserve)
- C Cam Jurgens, acquired in the Oct. 7 trade from the Eagles, cleared his red non-contact jersey for the first time in the concussion protocol, and coach Jesse Minter said he's confident Jurgens will start Sunday. [Baltimore Ravens](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/lamar-jackson-ravens-injury-report-cam-jurgens-tj-tampa-returns-practice-injured-reserve)
- CB T.J. Tampa was cleared to return to practice, opening his 21-day window to come off injured reserve after a season-opening knee injury. [Baltimore Ravens](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/lamar-jackson-ravens-injury-report-cam-jurgens-tj-tampa-returns-practice-injured-reserve)
- WR Rashod Bateman (shoulder), who left Sunday's loss in Cleveland early, was back at practice Wednesday. [Wacker](https://x.com/brianwacker1/status/2112952343150891084)
